summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py with a parametrized valid/invalid test plus a non-node input test. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (39 tests) under the shared venv. Not verified: mypy, black and isort are not installed in that venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only. Nothing was committed. Choices to review: modifier strings are literals instead of the ZeroOrMore constants (for type-checker compatibility), type-ignore comments sit on call lines rather than the with-line, and the test file is named test_extras_shacl.py.
